en.name: "I Am Spartacus!"
en.ability: Each day, up to half the living players (rounded up & Travellers don’t count) may publicly claim to be Spartacus.

revisions.v1: Each day, up to half the living players (rounded up & Travellers don’t count) may publicly claim to be Spartacus.

en.flavor: "The ego cuts deeper than the flesh." - Spartacus c. 103 B.C. - 71 B.C.
